title: Least-time Gradient Flow
abstract: arXiv:2610.01426v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Prescribing the speed of gradient flow on the risk itself, by the dynamics $\dot w=-u(E(w))\nabla E(w)/\abs{\nabla E(w)}^{2}$, makes the risk $e(t)=E(w(t))$ obey $\dot e=-u(e)$ exactly, whatever the landscape~$E$; the time needed to reach zero risk from $e_0$ is $\int_0^{e_0}\dd e/u(e)$. Minimizing this time alone is ill posed, and we study the regularized problem $\inf\{\int_0^{e_0}(\tfrac\lambda2\abs{u'}^{2}+1/u)\,\dd e:\ u\in H^{1}(0,e_0),\ u\ge0,\ u(0)=0\}$, $\lambda>0$. translated_abstract: 通过动力学方程 $\dot w=-u(E(w))\nabla E(w)/\abs{\nabla E(w)}^{2}$ 直接在风险（损失）本身上规定梯度流的速度，可以使风险 $e(t)=E(w(t))$ 精确地满足 $\dot e=-u(e)$，而与损失地形 $E$ 无关；从 $e_0$ 到达零风险所需时间为 $\int_0^{e_0}\dd e/u(e)$。仅最小化这一时间是不适定的，因此我们研究其正则化问题 $\inf\{\int_0^{e_0}(\tfrac\lambda2\abs{u'}^{2}+1/u)\,\dd e:\ u\in H^{1}(0,e_0),\ u\ge0,\ u(0)=0\}$，其中 $\lambda>0$。我们证明该极小化问题的解存在、唯一，且是一条线性缩放的摆线，并进一步证明最优速率在接近零风险时表现为 $u^{*}(e)\sim(9/(2\lambda))^{1/3}e^{2/3}$：其中指数 $2/3$ 与文献 betti2026holder 中通过幂律拟设所得结果一致，且落在 Hölder 区间 $(\tfrac12,1)$ 内——在此区间内，到达零风险的时间是有限的，同时权重速度趋于零。证明遵循经典路线：存在性由直接法给出，唯一性由……
tldr: 该论文提出在风险本身上直接规定梯度流速度使其精确按 $\dot e=-u(e)$ 演化，并通过正则化变分问题证明了最优速度剖面是线性缩放的摆线，且在零风险附近最优速率呈指数为 $2/3$ 的幂律，处于有限时间到达且速度趋零的 Hölder 区间内。
en_tdlr: This paper prescribes the gradient-flow speed directly on the risk so that it obeys exactly $\dot e=-u(e)$, and proves via a regularized variational problem that the optimal speed profile is a linearly scaled cycloid with near-zero-risk rate $u^*(e)\sim(9/(2\lambda))^{1/3}e^{2/3}$, lying in the Hölder window where arrival is in finite time with vanishing weight speed.
